name: Letterboxd Link
description: Letterboxd Link adds a small button to the movie details page that opens the film's Letterboxd page in a new tab, resolved from the movie's TMDb id. Requires the File Transformation plugin to also be installed. No configuration or account linking required.
overview: Adds a Letterboxd link button to each movie's detail page.
